title: Phillip H NDE 3191
date: The summer of 1955 June or July
content: My two younger brothers, R and H, were traveling with me passing the Farm home, and R said run the stop because the Road had a bump and it was fun to fly. I refused to run the stop to his disappointment, but had I done it I would not be sending you this. After stopping, I could see a vehicle a long way to the north as we were facing east. It was a thirty-five Mile Zone so I had plenty of time to cross. But little did I know the other pickup was going seventy-five mph and the driver was drunk. Though I was well over the center of the road, this man attempted to cross in front of me, and wound up hitting right where I was in the driver's side. I heard nothing and felt nothing. I found myself standing outside with a dark gray appearance that darkened my view as I stared and the pickup and the flashing lights arriving from the left. That triggered my awareness of my brothers and I began to cry, 'Where are my brothers,' again and again. In an instant, I found myself with my hands up to my head, blood running into my eyes. I lost consciousness, was in the Hospital overnight, and put on observation at home for two weeks. For years, I was left wondering why I felt that I have been thrown from the pickup. I never told anyone until I was reading about NDE's at the Brigham Young University in 1982 more or less. That is when my long awaited question was understood. What it did for me was to understand scriptures relating to the human soul. We are an intelligence clothed with the power of spirit created in the image of God in heaven before we are born. At conception, our spirit enters the embryo and begins earth life in the womb. The embryo would be dead otherwise and could not mature and develop otherwise. I experience a sense of knowing things without any previous knowledge about some people I meet that are complete strangers. At times, I have been given reprimands and warnings by a voice. I know that we are a spiritual being that enlivens the physical body that is a temple or tabernacle for the spiritual being that we are to learn from our earthy experience. While working in Huston, Texas. I was driving the 610 loop in the fast lane. I have been pondering over my life and feeling discouraged. Out of the blue, I was given this message... (I'm sorry, but I feel that I am not supposed to say anything at this time, I do not understand why, but when I have this feeling it is usually wise for me to follow my feeling.)

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: He reported: "I found myself standing outside" and seeing "the pickup and the flashing lights arriving from the left."
out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: He reported no sound or pain: "I heard nothing and felt nothing."

environment.environment_other_detail: Transitional roadside/accident scene with altered perception: "a dark gray appearance that darkened my view" while seeing the pickup and "flashing lights arriving from the left."

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Post-NDE aftereffects described: knowing things about strangers; reprimands/warnings by a voice; later received an unspecified message while driving.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE-like perception at the accident scene occurred without tunnel/light/arrival; then he was suddenly back in-body with blood in his eyes and later lost consciousness.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Visual alteration described as "a dark gray appearance that darkened my view" during the out-of-body-like scene at the accident site. He also reported later receiving reprimands/warnings by a voice and an additional (withheld) message while driving years later.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "I heard nothing and felt nothing." / "I found myself standing outside with a dark gray appearance that darkened my view" / "Where are my brothers" / "I found myself with my hands up to my head, blood running into my eyes."
